name: The Barrens Oases
summary: Beneath the Barrens, strange power stirs, and Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem takes heed from Thunder Bluff's Elder Rise. He sends travelers east through Mulgore to meet Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads and investigate the new waters.

sections.title: A Disturbance in the Drought
sections.body: For generations, the Barrens have known drought while Mulgore flourishes under the Earth Mother's care. Now tauren druids on Thunder Bluff's Elder Rise feel strange currents waking beneath the plains. Life stirs where it should not, and the Cenarion Circle fears the power behind it may endanger the land and its creatures.

sections.title: East Beyond Mulgore
sections.body: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem sends Tonga Runetotem to investigate the strange stirrings. The wilderness is too dangerous for one investigator, so Hamuul asks travelers leaving Mulgore to follow. Go east past Bloodhoof Village and through the mountain passes to the Crossroads, where Tonga waits for news. There, in the Barrens, stands the Horde's busy heart.

faq.q: Why is Hamuul Runetotem concerned about the Barrens?
faq.answer: Hamuul Runetotem and Thunder Bluff's druids sense an unnatural power flowing into the Barrens soil. Life quickens in a land known for drought, pointing to forces at work beneath the plains.

faq.q: Where can I find Tonga Runetotem?
faq.answer: Tonga Runetotem waits at the Crossroads in the central Barrens. Follow the main road east from Mulgore, then take the northern trail to the settlement.

faq.q: Is this quest only available to tauren?
aliases: can non tauren get barrens oases
faq.answer: Hamuul Runetotem offers this work mainly to travelers leaving Mulgore. Any Horde traveler can meet Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads and help investigate the oases.

faq.q: What awaits at the end of the road from Bloodhoof Village?
faq.answer: The road east from Bloodhoof Village crosses the mountain pass into the Barrens. Turn north at the fork to reach the Crossroads through the wilderness.

faq.q: What are the strange powers Hamuul senses?
faq.answer: The druids sense magical currents behind spring-fed oases in a land known for drought. Tonga Runetotem is there to learn whether this growth brings a blessing or dangerous corruption.

faq.q: Why are the Barrens considered so dangerous for young adventurers?
faq.answer: Raptors, plainstriders, and hostile centaur tribes roam the vast Barrens. Hamuul warns travelers to stay on patrolled trade paths, where the wilderness is less likely to overwhelm them.

angles.text: For a tauren leaving Mulgore's sacred meadows for the first time, this is a step into the wider duty of protecting Kalimdor's balance.
As a young druid trained under Hamuul Runetotem, you are entrusted to heed the earth and heal nature's fragile balance.
The Crossroads links the Horde's western holdings to the coast. A magical disturbance nearby brings deep strategic and spiritual concern.
